experiment: E-LEAN1: lean+1 single-feature re-tests + A1 production-backbone swap for the eFV lean ridge
spec: gate pre-registered 2026-07-05 before any run (this artifact, method block); motivated by the milb_missing precedent (bundle-rejected feature re-validated alone, +0.023) and docs/xfv-phase2-plan.md A1/A2
seed: n/a - harness fully deterministic (no stochastic steps; efv_lab_runner/efv_ml_lab forward-chained ridge)

method.protocol: forward-chained OOS on SCORED_YEARS 2020-2023, shipped lean ridge + consensus OLS anchor at shipped blend_lambda, debuted rows only, both eval targets (target_censored and target_resolved); additive variants via tools/efv_lab_runner.py (feature added to the shipped lean spec), replacement variant via tools/efv_ml_lab.py (explicit key list)
method.noise_floor: identity variant (fv duplicated as an extra ridge column, zero new information) run per side per target; epsilon = max |pooled Spearman delta| observed: hit 0.0023, pit 0.0035
method.candidates: computed in efv_model._vec but absent from the shipped lean sets: prod_trend, fv_trend, ops_rel, pos_prem, il_stints_pre, n_sources (hit); prod_trend, fv_trend, il_stints_pre, n_sources (pit); plus A1 swap ops_rel replacing obp_rel (hit). pick_overall / bonus_log / fv_stddev excluded (individually dead per phase-1 sweep, partial-given-FV ~= 0)

hit_ops_rel.verdict: FAIL (pooled within noise floor). NOTE: t45 improves on both targets (+0.0203 cen / +0.0061 res); see notes

hit_il_stints_pre.verdict: FAIL (gain below noise floor both targets)

hit_n_sources.verdict: FAIL condition 2: pooled gain exceeds noise floor on both targets BUT within_tier_wm degrades (0.1775->0.1597 cen, 0.1845->0.1728 res) and t45 degrades (0.0697->0.0579, 0.06->0.0438). Coverage/popularity proxy: adds cross-tier rank signal already visible to readers, dilutes real within-tier signal. The exact pattern the within-tier condition exists to reject

pit_il_stints_pre.verdict: FAIL (exact no-op: il_stints_pre is a constant column for the pitcher matrix, ridge assigns zero weight; pre-debut IL data effectively absent for pitchers in this vintage)

hit_ops_rel_for_obp_rel.verdict: FAIL (pooled +0.0001/+0.0002, deep inside the 0.0023 noise floor; wm flat-to-down on censored). t45 again improves (+0.0219 cen / +0.0077 res), consistent with the additive form

verdict: NO SHIP - all 11 variants fail the pre-registered gate. Shipped lean feature sets and data/xfv.json unchanged (byte-neutral). Third independent confirmation that the current matrix vintage is at its trainable-data ceiling for pooled ranking.
genuine_signal_recorded: ops_rel carries FV-45 fringe-tier signal the lean set misses: t45 +0.0203/+0.0219 (censored, additive/swap) and +0.0061/+0.0077 (resolved) with pooled flat. A t45-targeted change is NOT shippable under this gate (pooled-first) and was not pre-registered as such; any future attempt must pre-register a fringe-tier gate with a pooled no-degrade condition and address the wm dip (0.1775->0.1722 additive censored) before re-testing. Do not ship on this post-hoc subgroup observation.
do_not_retry: prod_trend, fv_trend, pos_prem, il_stints_pre, n_sources as lean additions against this data vintage (2011-2023 debut cohorts, SCORED_YEARS 2020-2023). Re-opening requires resolved 2024+ cohorts (new information), not a re-run.
